_about: Scheduled agent runs in the owner's workbench, run by .github/workflows/schedules.yml (hourly). Add or change entries by PR; any model may propose. Hours are UTC (Brisbane = UTC+10). Replies stay in LobeHub as topics; only status goes to the public record.

schedules.prompt: Morning brief for the owner. Use the Exagium tools: summarise the queue (open, waiting on the owner), the last 24 h of events (what finished, what failed) and the open PRs. Five short bullets, each with item ids or PR numbers. Do not open issues or PRs.
